tvShow.name: How Dare You!?
tvShow.overview: Rookie office worker Wang Cuihua is suddenly pulled into the world of a novel, where she meets Xiahou Dan, a powerful king hiding his true identity. Both outsiders to this world, they join forces to survive a twisted fate, facing political intrigue, ancient prophecies, and life-or-death choices. As they fight to change their destiny, a powerful bond forms, one that could reshape the future of the kingdom.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Wang Cuihua, a stressed corporate employee, is given a single day to provide an adaptation plan and evaluation for a clichéd web novel titled "Transmigrated: The Devil's Beloved Consort".

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: In an attempt to secure an ally, Yu Wanyin visited Xie Yong'er at Kunyu Palace. However, Xie Yong'er, also a transmigrator, viewed Wanyin through the lens of the original novel, remembering her as a cruel villainess who had previously pushed her into a pond.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Xiahou Dan brought Yu Wanyin to pay respects to the Empress Dowager. To lower her guard, he adopted a submissive stance, even apologizing for his own "terrible temper."

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Yu Wanyin narrowly escaped the library fire, but she was left injured and suffering from a high fever after leaping from the third floor into the water.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Just as the assassin's blade was closing in, the proprietress of the tavern intervened with startling speed, saving Xiahou Dan and Yu Wanyin.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Following the successful recovery of Xu Yao's records, Yu Wanyin and Xiahou Dan face a new political storm.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Yu Wanyin woke the next morning with a crushing hangover and a heart full of dread.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: On the pleasure boat, Xiahou Dan delivered a stirring address to the scholars, urging them to remain the "backbone of Great Xia" and hold onto their lofty ambitions.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: As preparations for the Flower Festival Banquet began, Yu Wanyin felt nothing but contempt for the palace's wastefulness while the common people faced starvation.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Confronted with Yu Wanyin’s relentless questions about his corporate identity, Xiahou Dan initially deflected, claiming a loss of memory to avoid shattering her trust.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Xiahou Dan explodes in rage upon discovering that the national treasury is completely depleted.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Xiao Tiancai arrived at Consort Xie's palace to treat her persistent cough, only for the two to recognize each other from a chance encounter on a rainy night.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Wanyin orchestrates a bold misdirection that shifts suspicion toward the Dowager Empress. Trust deepens between her and Xiahou Dan as war looms.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Court politics intensify when rumors of Wanyin’s fall from favor spread. Xiahou Dan balances reform, romance, and the threat of foreign invasion.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: As foreign envoys approach, pregnancy, deception, and survival collide. Loyalties fracture inside the harem.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: At a grand banquet, assassination plots unfold from multiple sides. Wanyin reveals her modern identity to Xie Yong’er, shattering illusions.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: Conspiracies escalate as rival factions plan regicide and regime change. Hidden motives behind the foreign delegation come to light.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: With betrayal on all sides, Xiahou Dan prepares to face an ambush at Beishan. Wanyin arms herself with a deadly new weapon.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: A violent showdown erupts at Beishan as assassins strike. In the chaos, alliances fracture and survival hangs by a thread.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: Trapped underground, Xiahou Dan confronts enemies and past trauma. Wanyin arrives just in time — but the cost is devastating.

episodes.name: Episode 21
episodes.overview: Poison, paralysis, and political fallout shake the capital. Xiahou Dan proposes peace, but his health begins to fail.

episodes.name: Episode 22
episodes.overview: A fragile alliance is signed as the Dowager Empress collapses. Romance blooms openly — but hidden consequences remain.

episodes.name: Episode 23
episodes.overview: As reforms begin, an ambush nearly claims Wanyin’s life. Xiahou Dan risks everything to protect her.

episodes.name: Episode 24
episodes.overview: After a near-fatal confrontation with Xiahou Bo, Wanyin is crowned Empress. But a new poison sends Xiahou Dan spiraling out of control.

episodes.name: Episode 25
episodes.overview: As funeral rites begin, Wanyin searches desperately for a cure. Xiahou Bo hardens his resolve for revenge.

episodes.name: Episode 26
episodes.overview: At the Dowager Empress’s burial, civil war erupts. Betrayal leads to devastating sacrifice and heartbreaking loss.

episodes.name: Episode 27
episodes.overview: On the run, Wanyin discovers Xiahou Dan’s hidden identity as fellow transmigrator “Zhang San.” The capital falls under Xiahou Bo’s control.

episodes.name: Episode 28
episodes.overview: Believed dead, Xiahou Dan secretly regroups with loyal forces. Wanyin refuses to abandon him and prepares to reclaim the throne.

episodes.name: Episode 29
episodes.overview: The emperor reunites with Wanyin as rebellion ignites. Old friends face impossible choices in a divided empire.

episodes.name: Episode 30
episodes.overview: A final coup erupts within the capital walls. Xiahou Dan and Wanyin publicly reclaim power, ending Xiahou Bo’s rebellion.

episodes.name: Episode 31
episodes.overview: With victory secured, reforms begin — but prophecy warns that only one of the “two stars” can survive. A deadly betrayal strikes from within.

episodes.name: Episode 32
episodes.overview: Wanyin risks everything to cure Xiahou Dan’s poison. As peace finally arrives, love transcends worlds — leading to a bittersweet reunion in modern times.
